text:
jordan (PM): Quick sync — I'm drafting the egress handover choreography for on-prem customers. Goal: a minimal playbook we can commit to for Q2. Need eng + SRE signoff on sequences, observability, and rollback.

tess (eng): High level: two safe flows: 
1) dual-eip window: attach customer IP alongside platform IP, switch traffic, then detach.
2) routing cutover: update route tables to point to customer NAT after validation.

omar (SRE): From SRE POV we need blackbox and infra signals: no 5xx app errors, TCP handshake rates stable, and flow-level bytes not dropping by >5% post-handover. Alert if any of those trip.

neha (solutions): Field context: two prospects asked for a 10m guaranteed IP preservation window during upgrades. They expect netops runbook + a dry-run option that doesn't actually flip production traffic.

tess (eng): Implementation plan: introduce EgressAllocation CRD + controller to manage the lifecycle. Sample operator control command:

```bash
# allocate customer IPs for tenant-42 without switching traffic
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: infra.redwood/v1
kind: EgressAllocation
metadata:
  name: tenant-42-staging
spec:
  cidrs: ["198.51.100.10"]
  intendedState: staged
EOF
```

Once staged, we can run a validation job that probes endpoints from the customer IPs. If OK, set intendedState=active to start traffic handover.

omar (SRE): Validation job should emit metrics: egress_probe_success{tenant} and probe_latency_ms. We'll need dashboards and a PagerDuty rule that includes handover owner.

legal (legal): Heads-up: some customers treat IP allocations as a procurement item. We should add a short clause to the order form around egress IPs and responsibilities.

neha (solutions): Runbook snippet request from field: include a dry-run flow and explicit rollback commands. Example rollback (idempotent):

```bash
# rollback: revert tenant to platform-managed egress
kubectl patch EgressAllocation tenant-42 --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"intendedState":"platform-managed"}}'
```

jordan (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal for an initial gated launch (P1):
- two enterprise customers complete a full staged handover dry-run with no app errors for 24h
- automatic rollback validated under simulated failure (controller + network failure) with recovery <30m
- status API exposes egress_mode + last_handover_ts for programmatic checks

tess (eng): We can add egress_mode to /status easily. Also can add a handover audit trail to control-plane logs: egress.handover.{tenant}.{event}.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly release window Thu 22:00-02:00 UTC. Any production handover must be scheduled outside that window.

omar (SRE): Performance/cost note: dual-eip windows mean retaining two external IPs for the cohort. Need to model cost per-tenant for canary windows >5m. Ops should approve budget for early customers.

neha (solutions): Also need preflight checks in installer: 1) provided CIDR routable, 2) trust anchors present for TLS, 3) firewall ACLs allow probe ports. Failure must surface as clear error in CLI output.

jordan (PM): Timeline ask: can eng produce a rough spike + PR that adds CRD + staged flow in 2 sprints? Tess?

tess (eng): Yes: spike in sprint 1 (CRD + staged lifecycle + status field), sprint 2 for validation job + canary runner + docs.

jordan (PM): OK locking that in as the draft plan. I'll add gating checklist to the planning doc and loop in Legal & Billing for the IP procurement note. Post any blockers here before EOD. :thumbsup:
